job.description: Test N2: when two readings must coexist in one state, does the ODE block give them different timescales, and does the model need them? Dual-head models on 5 new seeds, a dual-same control, and equalised and sham continuations from mid-training, after a short pilot. About 3 to 3.5 hours on a T4. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
